name: Rishiganga / Dhauliganga — 7 Feb 2021 Chamoli Rock-Ice Avalanche Flood (GLOF-type)
description: On 7 February 2021 a ~27 x 10^6 m3 rock-and-ice avalanche detached from the north face of Ronti Peak (Ronti Gad catchment), Chamoli district, Uttarakhand. The ice fraction fluidised over the 3.2 km drop, generating a debris-laden flash flood that swept down the Ronti Gad into the Rishiganga, destroyed the 13.2 MW Rishiganga hydropower project at Raini, then continued down the Dhauliganga and overwhelmed the under-construction 520 MW Tapovan Vishnugad project. 200+ people killed or missing. Well-documented event with multiple published discharge estimates.

structure.note: Not an engineered dam failure. Modelled here as a transient high-discharge inflow source routed over the real SRTM valley terrain (the framework's generic breach-inflow model). The avalanche source is Ronti Gad; the inflow point used for simulation sits on the Dhauliganga above Tapovan.

breach_event.cause: Rock-and-ice avalanche from Ronti Peak north face; ice fraction fluidised into a debris flow / flash flood.
breach_event.avalanche_composition: ~80% rock, ~20% glacier ice (Shugar et al. 2021, Science)
breach_event.discharge_source: HEC-RAS hydrodynamic reconstruction peak inflow 12,761.88 m3/s from a 26.4 x 10^6 m3 transient storage breach (Springer, Natural Hazards, 2023, doi:10.1007/s11069-023-05972-5). Consistent with Shugar et al. 2021 (Science) video-derived range of ~8,200-14,200 m3/s near the Rishiganga HEP. Other published point estimates along the system range 7,500-28,000 m3/s depending on reach and whether debris bulking is included.

infrastructure_destroyed: 520 MW Tapovan Vishnugad Hydro Electric Project (under construction) - intake, barrage, tunnel adit flooded

simulation_defaults.breach_width_note: Effective valley-floor inflow width at the modelling point (narrow Himalayan gorge). Tunable.
simulation_defaults.breach_hydrograph_note: The real surge was extremely rapid (minutes). Video timing at Tapovan implies a near-step rise; 8 min ramp used for numerical stability.
simulation_defaults.breach_latlon_note: Dhauliganga channel above Tapovan Vishnugad, within the fetched SRTM AOI. Inflow routed downstream over real terrain.
simulation_defaults.manning_n_note: Elevated roughness for a boulder-bed high-gradient Himalayan gorge with debris (typical 0.05-0.08).
